scope: Website redesign verification — real screenshots, professional layout, complete SEO

environment.server: local static file server on http://127.0.0.1:4173

checks.name: Local asset references resolve
checks.method: Node script scanned every src/href in index.html (31 unique references)

checks.name: JSON-LD structured data
checks.method: Parses as JSON; @graph contains WebSite, Person, SoftwareApplication, FAQPage

checks.name: SEO meta completeness
checks.method: description, canonical, og:title/description/image/url/site_name, twitter:card/image verified present

checks.method: Exactly one h1; all 4 img tags carry alt text and explicit width/height

checks.method: robots.txt references the sitemap; sitemap lists the canonical URL

checks.name: Removed content

checks.name: Desktop render
checks.method: Headless capture; OCR confirmed hero, 8 feature cards, quick access, screenshots gallery, privacy, download, FAQ all render with real app screenshots

checks.name: Mobile render
checks.method: Headless capture at 390px; OCR confirmed responsive hero with stacked layout and mobile nav toggle

checks.name: Release resolution
checks.method: Live GitHub API call resolved the current latest release (v1.4.1) into the download section headline

checks.name: Workflow YAML validity
checks.method: js-yaml parse of windows-tauri-release.yml and deploy-website.yml

checks.name: Frontend regression after version bump
checks.method: npm test (10/10 pass), npm run format:check (clean), npm run build (success)

notes: The VCRUNTIME140.dll startup fix is verified by the Windows workflow: the release build runs with RUSTFLAGS=-C target-feature=+crt-static and a post-build step fails the run if snapnote.exe still imports any Visual C++ runtime DLL.
Page weight: the published site dropped by approximately 1.5 MB after removing the mascot PNG; the four shipped PNGs are real application captures plus the generated social banner.
